_schema.description: Human-annotated gold action items, one entry per transcript in dataset/. Shape mirrors the JSON contract in PromptManager.ACTION_ITEM_PROMPT so gold and prediction can be compared field by field.

fields.individual_actions: assignee -> list of tasks explicitly committed to by that person
fields.team_actions: tasks the group committed to without a single named owner
fields.entities: named people appearing in the transcript

_schema.aliases: Optional per-task accepted paraphrases. Action items are free text, so the agent may phrase a correct extraction differently. Aliases widen what counts as a true positive without weakening the matching threshold.
_schema.annotation_rule: Only tasks explicitly committed to in the transcript. Suggestions, options under discussion, and hypotheticals are NOT action items - this mirrors the prompt's 'Only include what is explicitly mentioned. Do not infer.'
